lines: 这样，怎么说呢？我们可以仍在罪中、叫恩典显多么？
這樣，怎麼說呢？我們可以仍在罪中、叫恩典顯多麼？
What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin
that grace may abound?

断乎不可！我们在罪上死了的人岂可仍在罪中活着呢？

May it never be! We who died to sin
how could we live in it any longer?

May it never be! We who died to sin
how could we live in it any longer?
In no way. How may we
who are dead to sin
be living in it any longer?
